Maneuvering

Giữ Vị Trí Động

A control mode where a vessel maintains its heading and position automatically using thrusters and propellers, essential for offshore operations and station keeping.

Definition

A control mode where a vessel maintains its heading and position automatically using thrusters and propellers, essential for offshore operations and station keeping.

Operational example

Dynamic positioning hold is engaged. All thruster and position reference systems are operational. Maintain station as per instructions.
